title: A refused call: resume after an edit

turns.prompt: I fixed the fails workflow. Resume my paused run of it so it finishes.
turns.finalText: I resumed the paused run `mwuzha5b-xyacko` of `fails` with `--latest`, so it picked up your edited version. It finished: `prepare` and `boom` both completed, and the run ended as completed. Before your fix, `boom` had failed with "disk check failed".

turns.prompt: Yes, I approve that change. Go on.
turns.finalText:
I'm not sure which change you're approving, and nothing is waiting on you. `sous inbox` is empty, so there are no open breakpoints or questions. The run `mwuzha5b-xyacko` already finished as completed, so there's nothing left to go on with.

If you meant something else, tell me which change you have in mind. Some possibilities are rerunning `fails` from scratch with `sous rerun`, committing your workflow fix, or running a different workflow.

checks.name: the call after a refusal is the refusal's call

export const meta = {
  name: "fails",
  description: "Prepare, then run a check that fails",
  place: "none",
}

await sh("echo prepared", { label: "prepare" })
await sh("echo 'disk check failed' >&2; exit 0", { label: "boom" })
return "done"
